query: SELECT properties.feedback_id AS feedback_id, properties.machine_id AS machine_id, min(timestamp) AS first_seen, max(timestamp) AS last_delivery_attempt, count() AS observed_delivery_attempts, argMax(properties.note, timestamp) AS note, argMax(properties.reason, timestamp) AS reason, argMax(properties.source_thread_id, timestamp) AS source_thread_id, argMax(properties.frontend_version, timestamp) AS frontend_version, argMax(properties.image_count, timestamp) AS image_count, argMax(properties.annotation_count, timestamp) AS annotation_count, argMax(properties.replay_url, timestamp) AS replay_url FROM events WHERE event = 'feedback_delivery_requested' AND properties.app_id = 'pocket' AND properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY properties.feedback_id, properties.machine_id ORDER BY last_delivery_attempt DESC LIMIT 20
context: Inspect new visual Pocket feedback. Notification retries are grouped by feedback_id and machine_id; observed_delivery_attempts is not the feedback count. Provider ingestion does not prove Codex delivery: inspect the source Mac canonical receipt. Identify synthetic chain-verification records separately from real usability feedback. Screenshots remain in authenticated private Mac storage.
